name: Mumbai Interior
tagline: World-class furniture made in India — custom furniture and interiors
hero_title: Interiors and furniture for Mumbai homes, offices and shops
hero_text: Built by our own carpenters — on contract or labour basis, across Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Uttar Pradesh.
about: Mumbai Interior is a team of carpenters and interior workers serving Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Uttar Pradesh. We take on complete interior contracts and labour-basis work for homes, offices, shops, showrooms and malls, and we make furniture to measure in our own workshop.
address: RM36, Yadav Nagar, MIDC Road, Airoli, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra 400708
delivery_note: Delivery and fitting by our own team. We confirm any delivery charge before you order.
top_note: Labour basis & contract basis · Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Uttar Pradesh

work_modes.title: Contract basis
work_modes.desc: We handle the full job — design help, material, labour, finishing and fitting — for one agreed price.
work_modes.est: Priced per sq ft or per item, material included

work_modes.title: Labour basis
work_modes.desc: You buy the material; our skilled carpenters and workers do the work at labour rates.
work_modes.est: Labour from ₹250 – ₹450 per sq ft, or per-day rates

services.title: Home interiors
services.desc: Wardrobes, beds, TV units, false ceilings, wall panelling and full flat interiors.
services.intro: From a single wardrobe to a complete 2BHK, we plan, build and finish home interiors with our own carpenters. We work in new possessions and lived-in flats across Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai, and keep the site clean while we work.
points: Full flat interiors for 1, 2 and 3 BHK

services.title: Modular kitchens
services.desc: Kitchens with laminate or acrylic shutters, soft-close hardware and lofts.
services.intro: Kitchens built to your wall sizes, with laminate or acrylic shutters, soft-close hinges and channels, tall units and lofts. We measure on site and plan the kitchen around your sink, plumbing and gas line.
points: Straight, L-shaped, U-shaped and parallel layouts
Tall units, lofts and tandem baskets

services.title: Office interiors
services.desc: Workstations, cabins, reception counters, storage and conference rooms.
services.intro: Workstations, cabins and storage for offices of every size, planned around how your team works. We can work after hours and on weekends so your office keeps running.

services.title: Shops & showrooms
services.desc: Display racks, counters, shelving and complete shop fit-outs.
services.intro: Display racks, counters and complete fit-outs for shops and showrooms that need to look good and open on time.

services.title: Mall work
services.desc: Store fit-outs and fixtures built to mall timelines and rules.
services.intro: Store fit-outs and fixtures inside malls, built to the brand's drawings and the mall's timelines and night-work rules.
points: Work to brand and mall drawings
Night shifts and tight handover dates

services.title: Furniture to measure
services.desc: Sofas, beds, dining sets and storage made in our workshop.
services.intro: Sofas, beds, dining sets, wardrobes and storage made in our workshop to your size, wood and finish — plus repair and re-polishing of furniture you already own.
points: Sofas made to your room size
Beds with hydraulic or drawer storage
Delivery and fitting by our team

services.title: False ceiling & POP
services.desc: Gypsum, POP, PVC and grid ceilings with cove lighting, plus POP punning for walls.
services.intro: We design and fit false ceilings for homes, offices and shops — gypsum board, POP, PVC panels and grid ceilings — with cove lighting, spot lights and fan points planned with the electrician. POP punning gives walls a smooth finish before painting.
points: Gypsum board and POP false ceilings
Cove (hidden LED) lighting and profile lights
PVC ceilings for kitchens, bathrooms and balconies
POP punning and wall plaster finishing

est.item: Grid ceiling for offices (per sq ft)
POP punning on walls (per sq ft)

services.title: Painting
services.desc: Interior and exterior painting, texture walls, wood polish and waterproofing.
services.intro: Fresh paint for a single room or a full flat, with wall putty, primer and two coats from trusted brands. We cover furniture and floors, clean up every day, and can also polish wooden furniture and fix damp walls.
points: Interior repainting with putty and primer
Wood polish, PU and lacquer finish
Waterproofing for terraces and damp walls
Enamel paint for grills and doors

est.item: Interior emulsion paint (per sq ft of wall)

services.title: Electrical work
services.desc: Wiring, new points, lights, fans, MCB boards and repairs by trained electricians.
services.intro: Safe electrical work for homes, offices and shops — new wiring, extra points for your furniture and kitchen, lights, fans and distribution boards with MCBs. We plan points together with your interior work so nothing has to be broken later.
points: New switch, socket and AC points
Light, fan, geyser and chimney fitting

services.title: Plumbing
services.desc: Bathroom and kitchen plumbing, leak repair, taps, geysers and water tanks.
services.intro: Plumbing for new bathrooms and kitchens and quick repairs at home — concealed piping, taps and mixers, sinks, geysers, motors and tanks. We find and fix leaks without breaking more tiles than needed.
points: Kitchen sink, RO and dishwasher points
Tap, mixer, shower and WC fitting
Geyser, motor and water tank fitting

services.title: Aluminium sliding & aluminium work
services.desc: Sliding windows and doors, mosquito mesh, glass partitions and aluminium sections.
services.intro: Aluminium sliding windows and balcony doors in 2 and 3 track systems, with mosquito mesh and glass of your choice. We also make aluminium glass partitions for offices and shops, section doors, kitchen shutters and bathroom windows.
points: Old window repair, rollers and locks

services.title: ACP & composite panel work
services.desc: ACP cladding for shop fronts and buildings, HPL and WPC composite panels and doors.
services.intro: Aluminium composite panel (ACP) cladding gives shop fronts, showrooms and building elevations a clean, weather-proof finish. We also fit HPL exterior panels and WPC composite panels and doors that don't swell in the monsoon.
points: ACP shop front and elevation cladding
WPC panels for bathrooms and balconies

services.title: Shop & building name boards
services.desc: Shop sign boards, LED letters, glow sign boxes and building name boards.
services.intro: Name boards that people can read from the road — ACP boards with acrylic 3D letters, LED lit letters, glow sign boxes, and stainless steel or acrylic letters for building and society names. We make, deliver and fix them, including at height.

est.item: ACP board with 3D letters (per sq ft)
SS letters (per inch of height, per letter)

services.title: Grill fitting
services.desc: Window, balcony and safety door grills in MS and stainless steel.
services.intro: Strong grills for windows, balconies and doors, made to measure in mild steel (painted) or stainless steel. Choose straight bars, box grills with space for plants, or designer patterns. We also fix and repaint old grills.

services.title: Repairs & maintenance
services.desc: Carpenter, plumber, electrician and painter for every repair at home, office or shop.
services.intro: One call for all repair work — a carpenter for loose hinges, broken channels, doors and furniture; a plumber for leaks and taps; an electrician for switches and lights; and a painter for touch-ups. We also take yearly maintenance for offices and shops.
points: Furniture repair, hinges and drawer channels
Sofa and chair repair and re-upholstery
Yearly maintenance for offices and shops

faqs.q: How do you decide the final price?
faqs.a: The prices on this website are estimates. We give you a final quote after a site visit, once we know the exact size, wood or board, hardware and finish you want.

faqs.q: What is the difference between contract basis and labour basis?
faqs.a: On contract basis we supply the material and do the work for one agreed price. On labour basis you buy the material and pay us only for the work.

faqs.q: Which areas do you work in?
faqs.a: Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Mira Bhayandar in Maharashtra, and Kunda (Pratapgarh) and Prayagraj in Uttar Pradesh.

faqs.q: Do you visit the site before quoting?
faqs.a: Yes. Call or WhatsApp us on 9004200401 to book a site visit and measurement.

faqs.q: Can you make furniture in my size and wood?
faqs.a: Yes. Every piece on this website can be made to your size in teak, sheesham or engineered wood, with the finish you choose.
